cues: Noble metals like silver, gold and platinum do not dissolve.
They fall below the anode as anode mud, a valuable by product.
Active metals like zinc and iron dissolve but stay in solution.
The cathode copper is ninety nine point nine five percent pure, good enough for electrical wiring.
